terms.gloss: an augur: a member of the college of priests who read the will of the gods from birds and other signs
evidence: Cic. Leg. 2.20: interpretēs Jovis optumī maxumī, pūblicī augurēs (Lewis & Short)

phrases.latin: interpretēs Jovis optumī maxumī, pūblicī augurēs
phrases.english: the interpreters of Jupiter Best and Greatest, the public augurs

sources: Lewis & Short: augur
